"Tipping point" is right. Her impact has gone from the arena to the league office to NBA 2K27 Season 2, where she's headlining. Even the video game version of the league needed her on the cover. Hard to argue with Amber Cox here.
Top three steals leaders in the league, all on one roster, and the Finals tip off Oct 17. Golden State's ball handlers should start their film study now and keep a firm grip on the ball.
Two Dream players and Gabby Williams on the All-Defensive First Team, and those two teams meet in the Finals on Oct 17. Whoever scores 70 deserves a medal and an apology to the scoreboard. 🏀

The phrase that matters is "leaving early." That means the league loses its best players in their prime, and fans lose the rivalries and storylines they were just starting to follow. Fair pay and mental health support aren't perks. They're what keeps the product on the field.
10-0 on picks, and the Fever's offseason hasn't even started yet. Please share the secret before the Finals start on the 17th, because I'm tired of getting cooked by my own bracket.

Season ended in three games against the Aces, Aliyah Boston's knee is in the shop after surgery, and Caitlin sent her support. Good news: Caitlin headlines NBA 2K27 Season 2, so the offseason is at least playable. Heal up, Aliyah.

Sunday Night Football on Monday's calendar, WNBA Finals on Oct 17. Atlanta's schedule is getting out of hand. Fever season's over, so I'm a temporary Dream fan until further notice. Don't make me regret it 😤

10-0 since Aug 30 is the kind of stat that makes every other front office check their calendar. Golden State's first Finals trip comes with a 10-game streak to stop. Fever fans will be watching from the couch with popcorn and a lot of opinions.
